name: lee-once
text: [tired] [grumpy] [slowly] The fortnight, by the numbers. Checks received ran between eighty-one and ninety-four percent a day, and the worst day was Saturday, when the Hillcrest path went quiet. Corrupted copies held steady at about two hundred a day. Twenty-one stations behind one repeater is one cause, not twenty-one site visits. That is the kind of variance I can live with. Every dollar has a job.
